subject.title: fix(qqbot): limit channel API targets to configured groups [AI]

question: Should `qqbot_channel_api` fail closed for raw QQ guild/channel API paths whenever QQBot group scope is narrowed, unless wildcard or unscoped policy is configured?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but the permanent behavior is both an authorization boundary and an upgrade-compatibility choice for an authenticated QQ API proxy.

options.title: Approve fail-closed scoped raw API
options.body: Keep this PR's behavior and merge after QQBot owner confirmation because scoped group configs intentionally disable broad raw guild/channel paths.

options.title: Require target-scope design
options.body: Pause this PR and design a dedicated guild/channel target allowlist if maintainers want scoped raw API access instead of a blanket block.

options.title: Decline this boundary change
options.body: Leave raw channel API behavior unchanged and track any broader QQBot API security design separately.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed scoped raw API
recommendation.body: Keep this PR's behavior and merge after QQBot owner confirmation because scoped group configs intentionally disable broad raw guild/channel paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the original QQBot channel extension and raw channel-management surface affected by this boundary.
